corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The Commission register establishes the decision's 22 May 2023 issue date and identifies the attached request as M/593. The corrective JRC134461 locator at PDF p. 6 / printed p. 3 explicitly says the request was published on 22 May 2023; PDF pp. 8 and 16 link that account to C(2023) 3215 final. This corrects the retained prior month-only assessment without rewriting it. Article 4 of C(2025) 3871 expressly repeals C(2023) 3215, so the current status is repealed; no exact operative repeal date is inferred from eNorm expiration or the later decision's adoption date. Article 5's literal C(2019) 4281 reference is preserved as an anomaly, not silently corrected. CEN and CENELEC are addressees, while Commission authorship and adoption are recorded separately.

sources.verification_note: Corrective exact-date evidence: JRC134461 PDF p. 6 / printed p. 3 states that the European Commission standardisation request was published on 22 May 2023. PDF pp. 8 and 16 / printed pp. 5 and 13 identify the request as C(2023) 3215 final. This corrects, without rewriting, the retained earlier month-only source assessment. Retained PDF SHA-256: 3e322888198bf1c22b69cee815ac67d2ac27ea65724603b394b6d5a900006a67.

Limited publication-month evidence only: JRC134461 PDF page 8 / printed page 5 says the Commission standardisation request was published in May 2023, and PDF page 16 / printed page 13 identifies the referenced work as C(2023) 3215 final. It does not establish an exact publication day, make the 22 May adoption date a publication date, or establish the operative repeal day. The JRC report is retrospective evidence about the decision, not a republication of its complete text; retrieval time is not the decision's publication time. Retained PDF SHA-256: 3e322888198bf1c22b69cee815ac67d2ac27ea65724603b394b6d5a900006a67.
The Register of Commission Documents confirms Implementing Decision C(2023) 3215 final of 22 May 2023 and its attached standardisation request M/593.

C(2025) 3871 final PDF p. 7, Article 4 expressly repeals C(2023) 3215. It does not establish an exact notification or operative repeal date. Article 5 literally refers to C(2019) 4281 in its version of 22 May 2023; that anomaly is preserved and is not silently corrected. Retained PDF SHA-256: 617f68127736552ac968804dc2e7dd2293b0bb569fa38ab65cb5b3a0c5178384.
